llm_error.missing_config: Spark isn't set up yet. Open Settings and add your API key and model.
llm_error.unauthorized: The API key wasn't accepted. Check it in Settings.
llm_error.bad_request: The request couldn't be processed. Try again later, or check your settings.
llm_error.rate_limited: Too many requests right now. Wait a moment and try again.
llm_error.unavailable: The AI service can't be reached right now. Check your network and try again later.
llm_error.timeout: The AI service took too long to respond. Try again.
llm_error.total_timeout: This took too long and was stopped. Try a shorter request, or try again later.
llm_error.truncated: The reply was cut off. Try again, or ask for something shorter.
llm_error.thinking_exhausted: Spark ran out of room before it could reply. Try a shorter request, or try again.
llm_error.content_filtered: The reply was blocked by the AI service's content review. Rephrase your request and try again.
llm_error.inference_failed: Spark ran into a problem. Try again later.
llm_error.context_exceeded: This conversation is too long for Spark to handle. Start a new chat, or shorten your message.
llm_error.unknown_finish: Spark stopped without replying. No changes were made. Try again.
llm_error.unknown_finish_after_write: Spark stopped without replying. Some changes were already made, so check before trying again.
llm_error.unsupported_tool_calls: The current AI service can't be used with Spark. Choose a different model in Settings.
llm_error.invalid_response: Spark's reply couldn't be understood. No changes were made. Try again.
llm_error.invalid_response_after_write: Spark's reply couldn't be understood. Some changes were already made, so check before trying again.
turn.empty_reply_wrote: Your changes were made, but Spark gave no summary.
turn.empty_reply_tools_only: Spark did some work but gave no reply. No changes were made.
turn.empty_reply_nothing: Spark gave an empty reply. No changes were made. Try again.
turn.no_wrap_up: Spark reached its step limit for this request and stopped. Send a message to let it continue.
turn.content_unavailable: Spark can't access your content right now, so it can't continue. Try again later.
turn.unusable_response: Spark's reply couldn't be carried out. No changes were made. Try again.
turn.unusable_response_after_write: Spark's reply couldn't be carried out. Some changes were already made, so check before trying again.
turn.clarify_limit: Spark asked too many follow-up questions. Rephrase your request, or try again later.
turn.unbound: Spark can't start a chat right now. Try again in a moment.
turn.empty_prompt: Spark can't start a chat right now. Try again later.
turn.busy: Spark is still working on your last message. Wait a moment and try again.
turn.session_mismatch: This chat is no longer active. Open it again, or start a new chat.
progress.retrying: Having trouble reaching the service — retrying…
